measurements.name: catalog
sql: SELECT "public"."Product"."id", "public"."Product"."articleCode", "public"."Product"."name", "public"."Product"."desc" FROM "public"."Product" WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY "public"."Product"."id" ASC OFFSET $1

measurements.name: owner reservations
sql: SELECT "public"."Reservation"."id", "public"."Reservation"."userId", "public"."Reservation"."productId", "public"."Reservation"."quantity", "public"."Reservation"."status"::text, "public"."Reservation"."createdAt", "public"."Reservation"."closedAt", "public"."Reservation"."issuedById" FROM "public"."Reservation" WHERE "public"."Reservation"."userId" = $1 ORDER BY "public"."Reservation"."createdAt" DESC, "public"."Reservation"."id" DESC OFFSET $2
